scope: Whole test_aux_funcs.py and test_tee.py read. Three original TestAuxFuncs methods executed unchanged with unittest, no setup_module and no external fixture substitution.

findings.detail: Original marker test covers two entries and boundary-sized blocks using ordinary BytesIO with full reads. It does not exercise short reads from a seekable reader; v6 counterexample remains untested upstream.

test_recwalk assumes unsorted filesystem enumeration must differ from sorted order, including a general POSIX inequality assertion. Filesystems are permitted to enumerate in the sorted order; inequality is not an API invariant. Static test review, not an executed failure.
test_tee_stdout requires tell, seek and read on current stdout, unlike a typical terminal stream. A dedicated capturing runner is required; this test was not run.

not_run: Fixture-dependent path/recwalk/fullpath/version methods and both Tee tests. No claim of whole suite success.
